description: This file contains data models, helper functions, and code generation logic for producing Python bindings and dispatch code for PyTorch's C++ API. It defines data structures representing function schemas, Python argument signatures, and their conversion to C++ code, including handling of deprecated signatures, argument parsing, and type translations. The code also includes utilities for generating dispatch lambdas, argument binding expressions, and type annotations compatible with Python and PyTorch's internal codegen.

classes.name: PythonReturns
classes.description: Represents the return values of a Python function signature.

classes.name: PythonArgument
classes.description: Represents a Python function argument, including name, type, default value, and methods for generating argument strings for codegen.

classes.name: PythonOutArgument
classes.description: Represents output arguments in Python signatures, especially when multiple outputs are packed together.

classes.name: PythonSignature
classes.description: Encapsulates the schema of a Python function signature, including arguments, return types, and related methods for generating signatures for codegen.

classes.name: PythonSignatureDeprecated
classes.description: A specialized PythonSignature for deprecated functions, holding extra info for legacy signature handling.

classes.name: PythonSignatureNativeFunctionPair
classes.description: Pairs a PythonSignature with its corresponding NativeFunction, used in grouping signatures.

classes.name: PythonSignatureGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of Python signatures that share similar signature structure, with methods to create from pairs.

classes.name: DispatchLambdaArgument
classes.description: Represents an argument of the dispatch lambda function, including name, type, and whether it is an out argument.

classes.name: PythonArgParserOutputExpr
classes.description: Models the output expression after parsing Python arguments, used to generate binding code.

classes.name: DispatchLambdaArgumentExprs
classes.description: Holds expressions for binding PythonArgParser outputs to dispatch lambda arguments, including inits and expression mappings.

methods.name: str format_function_signature( name: str, arguments: Iterable[str] = (), return_type: str | None = None )
methods.description: Formats a Python function signature string given name, arguments, and optional return type.

methods.name: str argument_type_str( t: Type, *, simple_type: bool = False, symint: bool = True )
methods.description: Converts a Type to a Python type string for signatures, considering optional and list types.

methods.name: str argument_type_str_pyi(t: Type)
methods.description: Converts a Type to a string suitable for Python stub (.pyi) signatures.

methods.name: str return_type_str_pyi(t: Type)
methods.description: Converts a Type to a return type string for .pyi signatures.

methods.name: str returns_str_pyi(signature: PythonSignature)
methods.description: Generates the string representation of function return types for .pyi signatures, including structseq or tuple types.

methods.name: list[str] structseq_fieldnames(returns: tuple[Return, ...])
methods.description: Extracts field names used in structseq return types, based on return annotations.

methods.name: tuple[DispatchLambdaArgument,...] dispatch_lambda_args( ps: PythonSignature, f: NativeFunction, symint: bool = True )
methods.description: Generates the arguments for the C++ dispatch lambda, based on PythonSignature and NativeFunction.

methods.name: str dispatch_lambda_return_str(f: NativeFunction)
methods.description: Determines the C++ return string for the dispatch lambda, ensuring supported return types.

methods.name: str cpp_dispatch_target(f: NativeFunction)
methods.description: Determines the C++ function or method name for dispatch based on NativeFunction.

methods.name: tuple[str,...] cpp_dispatch_exprs( f: NativeFunction, *, python_signature: PythonSignature | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates the list of expression strings for arguments to pass to the dispatch lambda.
